<entry id="K00941">
<head-word>כֶּסֶל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. 
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="K00949"> כסס</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. חַרְצָא)</xref></language-reference></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>incision</italic>,] 
<italic>groin, loin</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Bekh. 40
<sup>a</sup>, v. כָּסוּל. Yalk. Gen. 133 (quot. fr. Midr. Vayisu) בכסא ימנית (corr. acc.) in the right loin.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּסָלִים, כְּסָלִין</plural-form>. Tosef. Bekh. IV, 10 [read:] כל שכְּסָלָיו יוצאין a 
<italic>kasul</italic> is one whose loins protrude. Sabb. 31
<sup>b</sup> וישׁ להם חלב על הכ' Ar. (ed. כִּסְלָם) and yet have fat on the groins (are careless).—Trnsf. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. טפש) 
<italic>laziness, inactivity</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>trust</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>thought</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Num. 742; Yalk. Ps. 819 quot. fr. Y’lamd. (v. Ar. s. v. כסל) כִּסְלָם … מחשבתם וכ' 
<italic>kislam</italic> (Ps. LXXVIII, 7) means their thought, as we read (Lev. III, 4, cmp. כִּלְיָה) ‘that which is by the loins’; (oth. opin.) טיפשותן it means their inactivity, as it is said (Koh. IV, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>5)</number>
<definition />
<notes> &c.; (oth. opin.) בטחונן their trust as we read (Job XXXI, 24) &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00949">
<head-word>כָּסַס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut, grind, chew, nibble</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ber. IV, 6 הכּוֹסֵס חטים he who chews wheat grains; Ber. 37
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 11 (ref. to אש אכלת, Ex. XXIV, 17) … שבע היו כוֹסְסוֹת זו בזו seven partitions (strata) of fire were eating into one another; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 45
<sup>a</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 15 בוססות (corr. acc.); v. טָכַס.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to make incisions, to mark, count</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Bo. s. 3; Pes. 61
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. V, 32
<sup>a</sup> bot., v. נָכַס.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pilp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כִּסְכֵּס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to chew</italic> &c. Tanḥ.</definition>
<notes> Vayigg. 3 מְכַסְכֵּס בשיניו cut (the bronze peas) with his teeth.—V. סִכְסֵךְ II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְכַּסְכֵּס, נִיכַּ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be gnawed at</italic> (by fire), 
<italic>be charred</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. IV, 62
<sup>c</sup> bot. בשביל שלא תִכַּסְכֵּס (prob. to be read תתכ') that it (the log) may not catch fire.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00950">
<head-word>כְּסַס</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut, chew</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 81
<sup>b</sup>; Ber. 36
<sup>b</sup> כַּס פילפלי וכ' if one chewed pepper on the Day of Atonement. Meg. 7
<sup>b</sup> בעאי למֵיכַס וכ' I should have liked to chew the plate after it; Yalk. Esth. 1059 דאִיכְסִיסֵיה (not דאיב').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to cut</italic> or 
<italic>scratch off, peel, diminish</italic>, (v. P. Sm. 1777),] 
<italic>to rebuke, chastise</italic> (v. כְּסַן).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. IX, 8 תִכוּס (ed. Lag. תָכֵיס 
<italic>Af</italic>.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַכֵּס, אָכֵיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give to chew</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 77
<sup>a</sup> אַכְסוּהוּ שערי וכ' give El. barley to chew (as to an animal, i.e. he is an ignoramus). Ib. על דא אכסוה וכ' on account of this (opinion), they gave El. barley to eat in Babylonia.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to rebuke, chastise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. l. c., v. supra. Ib. XXVIII, 23.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00951">
<head-word>כָּסַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to peel, whiten</italic> (cmp. חָסַף).</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. כָּסוּף, pl. כְּסוּפִים 
<italic>bright</italic>. Sifré Deut. 13 וותיקים כ' distinguished (of position), bright of intellect; ib. Num. 92 וכסופים.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכְסִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grow pale, fade, wither</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. III, 5 (expl. שיאור) כל שהִכְסִיפוּ פניו כאדם וכ' a dough the surface of which becomes pale and wrinkled, like (the sight of) a man whose hair (שַׂעַר) stands up from fright. Nidd. 47
<sup>a</sup> משיַכְסִיף ראש וכ' when the centre of the oblate portion of the breast begins to be wrinkled; Tosef. ib. VI, 4 משיִכָּסֵף (
<italic>Nif.</italic>). Sabb. 34
<sup>b</sup> ה' התחתון when the lower horizon becomes pale (is no longer red); Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>b</sup> bot.—Pes. 39
<sup>a</sup> פניו מַכְסִיפִין the leaves look faded (and curled); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to deteriorate, fall in value</italic>, opp. השביח (cmp. חָסַר).</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 30
<sup>a</sup> וה' ועמד על מנה and fell until it was worth only one Manah. Keth. 80
<sup>b</sup> שמא תַכְסִיף the soil may deteriorate (through neglect); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to put to shame; to frighten, to alarm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 35 (play on כֶּסֶף, I Chr. XXIX, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition />
<notes> שהיה מַכְסִיף כל הזהבים it alarmed all gold-workers (emptying their shops); Cant. R. to III, 10; Y. Yoma IV, 41
<sup>d</sup> top שהיה מ' בעד וכ' spread alarm among all the shops of &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְסַף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to grow pale</italic> &c., v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00952">
<head-word>כְּסַף, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>כְּסִיף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to feel ashamed, frightened</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Num. XII, 14 (h. text הכלם); a. e.—Arakh. 16
<sup>b</sup> דלִיכְסוֹף זרעיה וכ' that the seed of Rab should be put to shame through me. Taan. 22
<sup>a</sup> וכְסִיפָא להו מילתא וכ' Ms. M. 2 a. Rashi (Ms. M. 1 only וכסיפא להו, ed. ואִכְּסִיפוּ 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>) and the gentlemen (you) felt abashed to tell us; a. fr.—[Targ. Ps. XLI, 7 יכסף some ed., read: יכנף, v. כְּנַף I.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>כַּסֵּיף, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Af</italic>.</definition>
<notes> אַכְסֵיף </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to frighten; to put to shame</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XLIV, 10; a. fr.—Kidd. 81
<sup>a</sup> כַּסִּיפְתִּינָן (כַּסַּפְ') thou didst frighten us (by a false alarm). Ḥag. 5
<sup>a</sup> וכַסַּפְתֵּיה and thou didst put him to shame; Koh. R. end וכַסִּיפְתֵּיה. Sabb. 3
<sup>b</sup> דאי לאו … כספתיה וכ' for if he were not a great man, thou mightst have put him to shame, for he might have given thee an inappropriate reply. Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> מַכְסְפִיתוּ לי Ms. M. (ed. כסיפיתנן, corr. כַּסִּיפְתּוּנָן) you might have put me to shame; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to reduce in value, to cause deterioration</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 104
<sup>b</sup> מְכַסְּפֵי (or מַכְסְפֵי) they (the heirs) will neglect it (instead of improving).—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to feel ashamed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXXIV, 21 מַכְסִיף (prob. to be read: מַכְסַף or מְכַסַּף, part. pass.).]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְכַּסַּף, אִיכַּ', </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְכְּסֵף, אִיכְּסִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be made pale, to be frightened, to be put to shame</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job VI, 20; a. e.—Kidd. l. c. מוטב תִּיכַּסְּפוּ … ולא תיכספו מיני וכ' it is better that you of the house of Amram be frightened through me in this world, than that you should be ashamed of me (as a sinner) in the world to come. B. Bath. 111
<sup>a</sup>; Ab. Zar. 36
<sup>a</sup> איכ' he felt alarmed. Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup> אִיכַּסְּפָא ועיילא וכ' (missing in Ms. M.) she felt abashed and went &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="K00953">
<head-word>כֶּסֶף</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced. wds.) 
<italic>silver</italic>; (sub. מעה) 
<italic>a silver piece, M’ah</italic> (one sixth of a Denar, v. Zuckerm. Jüd. Münz. p. 15; p. 33, note 203); in gen. 
<italic>money, value</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. I, 1 בכ' by (handing to her) an object of value. Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> שמזונותיו תלויין בכַסְפּוֹ whose livelihood depends on his money (a money-lender). Shebu. VI, 1 הטענה שתי כ' the claim must amount to no less than two M’ah. Tosef. Keth. XIII (XII), 3 כ' בבל the Babylonian silver standard; כ' א"י the Palestinean &c. Ib. כ' שדיברה … זו היא כ' צורי זה ירושלמי wherever the Torah speaks of 
<italic>Kesef</italic> (as fines), it must be paid according to the Tyrian standard … that is the Jerusalem 
<italic>kesef</italic> (eight times the provincial 
<italic>kesef</italic> כ' מדינה, v. Zuckerm. l. c.); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כְּסָפִים</plural-form>. B. Mets. 42
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 31
<sup>b</sup> כ' אין להם שמירה וכ' coins given in trust are not duly guarded unless they are buried in the ground. Y. Yoma IV, beg. 41
<sup>b</sup> בשלשה … ובכ' by three methods was the land of Israel divided, by lots, by the Urim and Tummim, and according to the value of property; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00954">
<head-word>כְּסַף, </head-word>

<sup>d</sup> top מתמני בכ' appointed to office for money. B. Kam. 87
<sup>a</sup> אפחתה מכַּסְפָּהּ Ms. M. he lessened her value; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. כַּסְפַּיָּיא</plural-form>. Targ. Gen. XLII, 25; 35.—Y. Bicc. l. c. לא בכ' אתמני was it not through gifts of money that he was appointed?</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="K00956">

<entry id="K00957">
<head-word>כָּסִפְיָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<pos> pr. n. pl.</pos>

<definition>
<italic>to bend over, invert, turn upside down</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tam. V, 5 היה כּוֹפֶה עליהן וכ' he inverts a large vessel and puts it over them (the coals). Ib. כּוֹפִין אותה וכ' they invert it over &c. Pesik. Ekhah, p. 123
<sup>a</sup> כ' סיח את המנורה the ass (of gold, given as a bribe to the judge) has upset the lamp (offered on the other side; whence a proverbial expression for litigants outbidding each other in bribery); Y. Yoma I, 38
<sup>c</sup> bot.; Lev. R. s. 21; Pesik. Aḥăré, p. 177
<sup>a</sup>.—Esp. כ' את המיטה 
<italic>to upset the couch, to place the mattresses on or near the floor</italic>, as a sign of mourning, opp. to זָקַף. M. Kat. 15
<sup>b</sup> top [euphemistic version, read with Ms. M.:] דמות … בכם ובעונותיכם … כְּפוּ מיטותיכן וכ' I (the Lord) had placed my image among you, and for your sins I upset it (decreed death), upset now your beds; Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>a</sup> top כְּפֵה מיטתך. Ib. כבר כְּפִינוּם we have already lowered them (the couches); Y. Ber. III, 5
<sup>d</sup> bot. כפיטם (corr. acc.). Keth. 4
<sup>b</sup> כּוֹפֶה מיטתו he lowers his couch (when his wife is in mourning); כּוֹפָה מיטתה she lowers &c. (when her husband is in mourning); a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּפוּי, f. כְּפוּיָה, pl. כְּפוּיִים, כְּפוּיוֹת. Tosef. Ohol. XII, 2 סאה כ' על פיה a dry measure turned upside down. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥăn. 3) (play on כפי המלח, v. כַּף) כְּפוּיֵי מלחמה those upset by war. Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top מטה כ' a lowered couch; a. fr.—Esp. כְּפוּי טובה 
<italic>one on whom kindness is upset, ungrateful, unappreciative</italic>. Ab. Zar. 5
<sup>a</sup> כפויי טובה בני וכ' you ungrateful ones, sons of ungrateful ones. Lev. R. s. 4; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to press, force</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. V, 5 כּוֹפָהּ לעשות וכ' he may compel her to work in wool. Yeb. 106
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כּוֹפִין אותו עד וכ' the court uses means of coercion, until he says ‘I will’, opp. to בעל כרחו. Sot. 46
<sup>b</sup> כ' ללויה we force a host to escort (protect) his guest on parting. B. Bath. 12
<sup>b</sup> כגון זו כ' על מדת סדום in such a case we apply force on the ground of the law of equity (v. סְדוֹם). Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>c</sup> top וכוֹפִין do we compel (a son to support his father)? Ib. כופין את הבן we do compel &c.—R. Hash. 28
<sup>a</sup> כְּפָאוֹ ואכל וכ' if somebody forced him, and he ate Matsah (on the first Passover night). Ib. כ' שד a demon possessed him. Ib. כְּפָאוּהוּ פרסיים Persians (gentiles) forced him; a. fr.—[Snh. 70
<sup>b</sup> כפאתו, v. כָּפַת.]—V. כּוּף I a. כָּפַף.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

<definition>

<entry id="K01043">
<head-word>כָּפַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bend, curve</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 87, end כּוֹפֶפֶת אני את קומתך … כְּפוּפִים (Potiphar’s wife said to Joseph) I shall bend thy proud stature (humiliate thee with slave labor); said he, The Lord erects those who are bowed down. B. Kam. 55
<sup>b</sup> הכּוֹפֵף … בפני וכ' he who bends his neighbor’s grain stalks before the fire (so as to make them catch fire). Num. R. s. 6, beg. נביא כופף ידיו וכ' the prophet must bend his hands and feet to sit before (surrender his power to) the high priest; (Y. Hor. III, 48
<sup>b</sup> bot. מְכַפֵּת). Cant. R. beg. לָכוֹף אזניך וכ' to bend thy ear and listen; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּפוּף, f. כְּפוּפָה, 
<plural-form>pl. כְּפוּפִים, כְּפוּפִין; כְּפוּפוֹת</plural-form>. Sabb. 17
<sup>a</sup> היה הלל כ' ויושב וכ' Hillel sat bent (in submission) before Shammai. Gen. R. l. c., v. supra. R. Hash. III, 4 בשל זכרים כ' with bent horns of rams. Yalk. Ex. 276 דווים וכ' suffering and humbled (v. סָגַף, סָחַף); a. fr.—Esp. the 
<italic>curved letters</italic> כ, נ, פ, צ, opp. פשוט the straight-lined, the shape of the final letters. Sabb. 104
<sup>a</sup> (symbolization of letters) נו"ן כ' … נ̇אמן כ' וכ' 
<italic>Nun</italic> bent, 
<italic>Nun</italic> straightened, faithful when bent (in distress), faithful when straightened (raised up) &c. Ib. 103
<sup>b</sup> כ' פשוטין וכ' that one must not write the curved letters straightened &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bend, force, conquer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. I, 18
<sup>a</sup> bot. מומחה שכ' ודן an authorized judge that forced (the law requiring three judges) and judged singly. Y. Yeb. XII, 12
<sup>c</sup> ר' יצחק כ' R. J. forced (the law requiring three judges for 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ălitsah</italic>); ib. הא רבן כ' it was our teacher who did it. Keth. 4
<sup>b</sup> אין לָכוֹף וכ' … no husband dares force his wife (in mourning) to paint &c. Num. R. s. 14 (play on כף) זה אברהם שכַּף את יצרו וכ' (some ed. שכפף) that refers to Abraham who conquered his inclinations &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to invert, upset</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top גרמתני לכוֹפְפָהּ thou didst cause me to upset it (the divine image), v. כָּפָה; (M. Kat. 15
<sup>b</sup> ובעונותיכם הפכתיה). Y. l. c. מטות כְּפוּפוֹת = כְּפוּיוֹת, v. כָּפָה; a. fr.—[Num. R. s. 10 כפפתו אימו, read כפתתו, v. כָּפַת.—Sabb. 106
<sup>a</sup> הסיט כפוף Ar., ed. כָּפוּל, v. סיט.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bend one’s self upon, to take pains</italic> (cmp. כְּפַל).</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to I, 17 כפפתי לעקור וכ' I took pains to destroy the passion for idolatry.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכְפַּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be bent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 28 [read:] עד שנִכְפְּפָה קומתם וכ' so that their statures were bent under their load. Arakh. 19
<sup>a</sup> שרביט שאינו נכפף a staff (of gold or silver) which cannot be bent. Num. R. s. 5, end נִכְפְּפָה היריעה וכ' the curtain around the Ark was bent aside (prob. to be read נכפלה). B. Kam. 61
<sup>a</sup> בנִכְפֶּפֶת when the fire is diverted from its course through the wind; (oth. opin.: when the fire is subdued (low) and creeping over the plants on the ground), opp. קולחת or קודחת. Cant. R. to I, 17. Pesik. R. s. 14 שתי השערות נִכְפָּפוֹת (not … פים) the two hairs (on the neck) are bent, opp. נזקפות; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
